rationale: The chunks address some design changes (Age Transition options in 1.2.3–1.2.4, Test of Time feature allowing same-civ play, leader differentiation in 1.3.2) but do not directly ground the player's core complaint about loss of 'building a civilization' feel, lack of world customization, or unrecognizable leaders. An ideal responder could acknowledge that the design has evolved and cite some tuning efforts, but cannot fully validate or substantively engage with the philosophical complaint without chunks that explicitly address the civilization-building philosophy or world customization options.
